requirement_vague: Updating a todo with mismatched ID returns bad request

omissions.description: The PUT /todos/{id} endpoint does not check whether the id in the request body (todo_in.id) matches the path parameter id. When they differ, no 400 Bad Request is returned.
omissions.reasoning: The update_todo function retrieves the todo and updates it without ever comparing todo_in.id to the path parameter id. The TodoUpdate model includes an optional id field, but the handler ignores it entirely, so a mismatch between the body id and the URL id is never detected and no 400 response is produced.
